headline: Roosevelt unbeaten and scoring like no one else
dek: Roosevelt have scored thirteen goals and conceded six without losing, more than Davenport, Purdue Northwest and Wisconsin-Parkside have managed between them. Purdue Northwest and Saginaw Valley State are the only other sides unbeaten, and Saginaw Valley State kept that by beating Northern Michigan in the season's first meeting between members.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Saginaw Valley State have spread ten goals across seven different scorers and conceded five. The chart ranks what sides score; the sides scoring most are also the ones that have not lost.

wire.line: Saginaw Valley State beat Northern Michigan in the season's first meeting between members and remain unbeaten.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Estefano Alvear has saved eighteen shots and conceded three goals for Purdue Northwest, a save percentage of .857.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Luca Rosen has scored four of Northern Michigan's eight goals, from thirteen shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Roosevelt's four wins are more than any other programme has managed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andrés García has scored three of St. Cloud State's four goals, from eleven shots, while the side has conceded eleven.

last_match.line: St. Cloud State's only win of the season came at Truman; every match since has been a defeat.

next_match.line: Davenport are still without a win; the draws at Northwood and Tiffin ended a losing start.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
